Warning for Fishermen 18.09.2026 / 0600 HRS IST
Weather warning for fishermen for Andhra coast valid for next four (4) days commencing
from 0600 Hours IST of 18.09.2026:
Day 1 (18.09.2026) to Day 4 (21.09.2026): Nil.
Weather warning for fishermen for Bay of Bengal (other than Andhra coast):
Day 1 (18.09.2026): Squally weather with wind speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to
prevail over Andaman Sea.
Squally weather with wind speed 40-50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph is likely to prevail over Andaman
Sea and some parts of Southeast Bay of Bengal.
Day 2 (19.09.2026): Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail
over few parts of southwest Bay of Bengal.
Squally weather with wind speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail over some
parts of Andaman Sea.
Squally weather with wind speed 40-50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph is likely to prevail over Andaman
Sea and some parts of Southeast Bay of Bengal.
Day 3 (20.09.2026): Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail
over few parts of Southwest Bay of Bengal.
Squally weather with wind speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail over some
parts of Andaman Sea.
Squally weather with wind speed 40-50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph is likely to prevail over Andaman
Sea and some parts of Southeast Bay of Bengal.
Day 4 (21.09.2026): Squally wind with speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail
over few parts of southwest Bay of Bengal.
Squally weather with wind speed 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph is likely to prevail over some
parts of Andaman Sea.
Squally weather with wind speed 40-50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph is likely to prevail over Andaman
Sea and many parts of Southeast and some parts of Eastcentral Bay of Bengal.
Fishermen are advised not to venture into the above sea areas during the above mentioned
period.
PORT WARNING: Nil.
HIGH WAVE ALERT: Nil.
OCEAN CURRENT ALERT: Nil.
SWELL SURGE ALERT: TAMILNADU
KANNIYAKUMARI: Swell Surge Alert for the coast of KANNIYAKUMARI,TAMIL NADU from
Neerodi To Arockiyapuram. Swell waves in the range of 16.0 - 18.0 sec period with 1.2 - 1.7 m
height are forecasted during 20:30 hours on 18-09-2026 to 11:30 hours on 19-09-2026. It advised
that there is a possibility of surging of waves, boats to ply with utmost vigilance, recreation with
due care.
RAMANATHAPURAM: Swell Surge Alert for the coast of RAMANATHAPURAM,TAMIL NADU
from Rojma Nagar To Theerthaandathanam. Swell waves in the range of 16.0 - 19.0 sec period
with 1.2 - 1.6 m height are forecasted during 17:30 hours on 17-09-2026 to 23:30 hours on 19-09-
2026. It advised that there is a possibility of surging of waves, boats to ply with utmost vigilance,
recreation with due care.
THOOTHUKKUDI: Swell Surge Alert for the coast of THOOTHUKKUDI,TAMIL NADU from
Periyathalai To Vembar. Swell waves in the range of 16.0 - 19.0 sec period with 1.1 - 1.6 m height
are forecasted during 23:30 hours on 18-09-2026 to 23:30 hours on 19-09-2026. It advised that
there is a possibility of surging of waves, boats to ply with utmost vigilance, recreation with due
care.
TIRUNELVELI: Swell Surge Alert for the coast of TIRUNELVELI,TAMIL NADU from Kuttapulli To
Kooduthalai. Swell waves in the range of 15.0 - 18.0 sec period with 1.2 - 1.8 m height are

is a possibility of surging of waves, boats to ply with utmost vigilance, recreation with due care.
